info.title: MobiDuka Retail POS API Blueprint
info.description: Multi-tenant, offline-first production backend engine supporting Flutter mobile clients and Kenyan retail ecosystems (Cash tracking, M-Pesa records, local synchronization syncing).

bearerAuth.description: JWT issued by /auth/login. Use the token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

tags.name: Business
tags.description: Tenant operations, cash, procurement, expenses, and reports

200.description: Business profile
Updated business profile

get.description: Requires the authenticated user's business settings permission. Returns the latest completed backup and up to 20 completed or failed attempts, including manual/automatic source, byte size, retry count, and device-cache counts.

200.description: Latest completed backup in backup plus recent attempts in backups; backup contents remain encrypted.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped device snapshot upload. triggerType marks manual or automatic runs; collection and queue counts are persisted for backup history. Configure BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the uncompressed JSON snapshot.

200.description: Idempotent retry for an existing backup.

503.description: Server backup encryption is not configured.

put.description: Accepts one gzip archive chunk of at most 256 KiB. Re-uploading an identical chunk is idempotent; a different payload at the same index is rejected.

200.description: Chunk stored or an identical retry was already present.

404.description: Backup was not found in this business.

409.description: Chunk index already contains different data.

post.summary: Verify and complete a cloud backup
post.description: Authenticates/decrypts each chunk, checks the gzip archive and SHA-256 checksum, verifies tenant and snapshot format, then marks the backup complete.

200.description: Backup completed or an identical completion retry was already recorded.

400.description: Backup integrity, checksum, or snapshot validation failed.

404.description: Backup was not found in this business.

409.description: Backup is missing one or more chunks.

503.description: Server backup encryption is not configured.

post.summary: Persist a failed device backup attempt

200.description: Failed attempt recorded.

404.description: Pending device backup was not found.

post.summary: Restore a completed encrypted cloud backup
post.description: Requires the authenticated user's business settings permission. Selects the latest completed backup when backupId is omitted, decrypts and verifies its AES-256-GCM chunks server-side, and returns the tenant-matched offline snapshot. The client should confirm before replacing local collections and queued sync records.

backupId.description: Optional completed backup ID; omitted to restore the latest completed backup.

200.description: Verified offline cache snapshot for the authenticated business.

400.description: Invalid restore request or backup ID.

404.description: No completed backup was found for this business.

422.description: Backup chunks, checksum, archive, or snapshot failed integrity validation.

503.description: Server backup encryption is not configured.

get.summary: Get full server business backup history
get.description: Requires authenticated business settings permission. Returns completed metadata and failed attempts, including automatic/manual source, record count, retry count and failure reason; snapshots remain encrypted at rest.

200.description: Latest completed server backup in backup plus recent completed or failed attempts in backups.

post.summary: Create a full tenant-scoped PostgreSQL business backup
post.description: Reads business-owned records in a repeatable-read transaction, serializes and compresses the snapshot, encrypts each chunk with AES-256-GCM, and stores up to 10 completed server backups in the same PostgreSQL database. Includes credential hashes and encrypted payment credential records; shared payment-method definitions and backup archives are excluded. Only authorized server-side restore can access plaintext. This is not protection from loss of that database; maintain an independent off-site backup. Requires BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

409.description: Server data has inconsistent tenant relationships; no backup was stored.

503.description: Server backup encryption is not configured.

500.description: Server backup could not be created.

get.summary: Run the daily automatic full-business backup job
get.description: Scheduled daily at 06:00 UTC by Vercel Cron. Requires CRON_SECRET in production. Creates a full-business backup for each business with automatic backups enabled and records failed attempts.

200.description: Automatic backup run totals.

post.summary: Restore a full server business snapshot without deleting current-only rows
post.description: Requires authenticated business settings permission. Decrypts and verifies a completed snapshot, then transactionally upserts tenant rows. Snapshot values win for matching primary IDs; current rows absent from the snapshot are retained. Business and credential records are included. Unique-key or foreign-key conflicts roll back the entire restore.

200.description: Server snapshot restored; rows absent from the snapshot were retained.

404.description: Completed server backup not found for this business.

422.description: Backup integrity or tenant validation failed.

503.description: Server backup encryption is not configured.

500.description: Restore transaction failed; no rows were committed.

200.description: Business settings, including automatic backup and Wi-Fi-only preferences

schema.description: Accepts businessId, taxPin, taxConfig, autoBackup, autoBackupFrequency (DAILY, WEEKLY, or MONTHLY), and autoBackupWifiOnly.

200.description: Updated settings

post.description: Handles standard credential authorization maps for owners and fast PIN code verification sequences for shift cashiers.

schema.description: Use the owner password example or the cashier PIN example. Do not send password and pin together.

200.description: Authentication successful, returns active JWT token parameters.

401.description: Invalid user credentials or mismatched secret keys.

post.summary: Atomic Queue Transaction Sync Synchronization Endpoint
post.description: Processes a collection array of chronological state logs generated offline on the local device.

deviceId.description: Seeded device ID for Main Counter Tablet.

userId.description: Seeded deployed owner ID. For another deployment, use the authenticated user id from login.

200.description: Batch synced, returns processing counts and archived item arrays.

500.description: Atomic transaction database failure exception thrown.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Sale ID returned as nextCursor on the preceding page.

200.description: Receipt page returned.

404.description: Business not found.

businessId.description: Seeded deployed business ID. For another deployment, use businessId from the login response.

userId.description: Seeded deployed owner ID. For another deployment, use the authenticated user id from login.

subtotal.description: Pre-discount item subtotal. Defaults to the sum of item line prices.

201.description: Sale created and stock adjustments complete.

put.summary: Assign or clear the registered POS device's current cash shift

cashSessionId.description: Set to null to clear the current shift.

200.description: Device current shift assignment was saved.

409.description: The device is inactive or registered to another business.

get.summary: List cash sessions and shift performance

200.description: Sessions ordered from earliest start to latest, including cashier, shift type, sales count, and revenue. Open sessions have closedAt set to null.

post.description: Triggers daily shift ignition sequences or processes shift totals with dynamic computed cash variances.

businessId.description: Seeded deployed business ID. For another deployment, use businessId from the login response.

userId.description: Seeded deployed owner ID. For another deployment, use the authenticated user id from login.

sessionId.description: For CLOSE, use the sessionId returned by the OPEN action.

200.description: Purchase orders with suppliers and items returned.

post.description: Logs new wholesale distributor order sheets or automatically closes them out to increment store stock items.

businessId.description: Seeded deployed business ID. For another deployment, use businessId from the login response.

orderId.description: For RECEIVE, use the orderId returned by CREATE.

200.description: Order batch received and inventory stock level metrics updated.

post.summary: Customer Credit Ledger & Debt Book Tracking
post.description: Records credit charges generated during point-of-sale checkout or applies repayments to a customer's outstanding balance.

businessId.description: Seeded deployed business ID. For another deployment, use businessId from the login response.

customerId.description: Create a customer first, then use the returned customerId; the seed does not create customers.

creditBookId.description: Optional for CHARGE_CREDIT; the API generates this ID when omitted.

userId.description: Seeded deployed owner ID; use the authenticated user id for repayments.

400.description: Invalid amount, unsupported action, or repayment exceeds the outstanding balance.

404.description: Customer was not found in the requested business.

post.description: Requests a customer PIN prompt through the server-selected Daraja environment and stores the pending checkout correlation record against the authenticated tenant integration. Use the tenant ID returned by login; the seed generates business UUIDs at runtime.

businessId.description: Seeded deployed business ID. For another deployment, use businessId from the login response.

phoneNumber.description: Seeded business phone in Kenyan format; replace with the customer's handset number for a real checkout.

200.description: STK request accepted by Safaricom.

400.description: Invalid business, phone number, or amount.

404.description: The supplied businessId does not belong to a known business tenant.

post.description: Processes the asynchronous Daraja callback and records the transaction result and receipt number.

200.description: Callback acknowledged and transaction status recorded.

get.description: Requires the payments permission. Returns configuration status and public account fields only; credential values are never returned.

200.description: Public M-Pesa integration status returned.

put.description: Requires the payments permission. The server encrypts credential fields before storage and returns only public setup metadata.

200.description: Encrypted M-Pesa integration saved.

400.description: Invalid account details or missing first-time credentials.

post.description: Checks the webhook cache first, then queries Safaricom for a pending STK transaction until it completes or fails.

businessId.description: Authenticated tenant ID returned by login.

checkoutRequestId.description: Use checkoutRequestId returned by /payments/stk-push or persisted by the M-Pesa callback.

200.description: Returns SUCCESS, PENDING, CANCELLED, or FAILED.

get.summary: Query or Search Registered Customer Profiles
get.description: Returns customers for a tenant, optionally filtered by name or phone number. The query filter is case-insensitive.

200.description: Customer profiles returned successfully.

400.description: Invalid profile data or duplicate phone number.

get.summary: Aggregate dashboard summary for a tenant
get.description: Returns the dashboard metrics used by the web app and Flutter dashboards, including revenue, cash, low stock, recent sales, and scan activity for the seeded tenant.

parameters.name: businessId
parameters.description: Seeded deployed business ID from the demo tenant.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Backward look window in days. Defaults to 30.

200.description: Dashboard summary assembled from real sales, expenses, cash sessions, inventory, and scan events.

404.description: Business not found.

get.summary: Look up a product by barcode and record scan activity
get.description: Returns product details for a scanned barcode and logs the event for the authenticated tenant. The seeded demo catalog includes printer-friendly barcodes such as 6191000000158 for Safaricom Airtime 100 KES.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: Barcode to lookup in the store catalog.

200.description: Lookup completed and scan logged.

400.description: Authenticated business and barcode are required.

500.description: Failed to look up scanned product.

post.summary: Process scan actions for lookup, add-to-cart, and restock
post.description: Allows clients to look up a product, add it to a cart, or add inventory through a barcode-driven restock action. The demo tenant includes owner and cashier accounts like owner@mobiduka.com / OwnerPass123 and cashier1 / 2540.

200.description: Restock completed successfully.

201.description: Lookup or add-to-cart action completed and the scan event was persisted.

400.description: Malformed payload or invalid action/status combination.

403.description: User does not belong to the authenticated business.

404.description: Unknown barcode for a restock request.

get.summary: Tenant Analytical Sales and Profit Summary
get.description: Returns tenant-scoped revenue, cost, expense, profit, inventory valuation, low-stock, open-shift, and daily trend metrics.

200.description: Analytical summary and chronological daily trend frames returned.

get.summary: Export the authenticated business sales ledger as CSV
get.description: Requires the authenticated user's Export Data permission. Business scope is derived from the bearer token; client-supplied business IDs and roles are not accepted. Streams paginated sales rows with item and payment details. Optional UTC date filters are inclusive.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Include transactions on or after this UTC date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Include transactions through this UTC date.

200.description: CSV attachment containing the transaction ledger.

400.description: Invalid date filter or reversed date range.

404.description: No transactions were found for this business and date range.

500.description: Unable to generate the sales ledger.

200.description: Roster array generated successfully.

post.summary: Provision or Update a Staff Employee Account

400.description: Invalid role, tenant, or employee configuration.

post.description: Saves the inquiry in the platform-admin Support inbox and emails it to the configured MobiDuka contact inbox through Resend. Configure RESEND_API_KEY and a verified sender in CONTACT_EMAIL_FROM or BILLING_EMAIL_FROM. The recipient defaults to owner@mobiduka.com and replies are directed to the submitted email address. A saved request is accepted even if the notification email cannot be delivered.

201.description: Contact request saved. The response includes whether the notification email was delivered.

400.description: Request body or contact details are invalid.

502.description: Email provider could not deliver the contact request.

500.description: Contact request could not be saved.

200.description: Website enquiries including contact details, message text, and email delivery status.
